name: CitiPort Financial Services Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, CitiPort Financial Services Ltd is in the business of investment and financing[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
CPFSL provides various  financial services in India including loans, leasing services, and investment in shares. The company is registered as a Non-Deposit taking Non-Systematically Important Non-Banking Financial Company which is primarily engaged in Investment and Credit

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.72% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.86% over last 3 years.
